description: Regression pin for the phase-aware selection lookup: the datasheet hotkey (I) must keep working in the MOVEMENT phase, where it already did, after _selected_unit_id_or_empty() was reworked to read each controller's own selection field. Selects a unit through the real movement UI, presses I, asserts the card opened for that unit and that ESC closes it.
